snippet.title: cage grind full onboarding 16x9
snippet.description:
Every champion starts somewhere. This is where your climb begins.

Watch the full Cage Grind onboarding—from creating a fighter and choosing a name to setting a fight plan, earning your first win, and spending your first permanent attribute point. Then open collectible rewards, check the Cage Feed, and step into Open Gym for a practice round and coach feedback.

Cage Grind is a free browser-based MMA career game. Build your fighter, grow your following, attract sponsors, and chase the World Championship.

🥊 Play free: https://cagegrind.com
📣 Follow: https://www.facebook.com/CageGrind

Created by independent developer Jay Jones.

#CageGrind #MMAGame #BrowserGame #IndieGame #Gameplay
